consequence.statement: Operators gain the option to use mTLS when a Provider sends alerts to an external system; the release notes state no failure, rejection, ignored setting or required migration for existing setups.

assertion.statement: Flux 2.7.0 adds support for mTLS when a Provider sends alerts to external systems.
